Editorial · Coffee-table book

A city, explored one spread at a time.

A photography-led coffee-table book about Busan’s culture, coastline, food, and everyday experiences.

RolePublication & layout design
ScopeBook cover, contents, image and text layouts
ContextEditorial project

The direction

Let the destination lead

The book presents Busan as a place to discover through its landscapes and culture. Large photographs and an airy title treatment establish the visual direction, with supporting text adding context.

Editorial system

A journey across the city

The spreads cover themes including festivals, beaches, temples, and food. The page system combines photography and short text blocks to build a varied but connected reading experience.

Outcome

What the work brings together.

A coffee-table book design with a cover, contents, and thematic spreads that organize a city narrative through photography and typography.
